subject.title: [Feature]: Enrich before_tool_call event with action classification and input provenance

question: What public policy-facts contract should before_tool_call expose: action categories, composable capability flags, input/requester provenance, external-content provenance, or a versioned combination?
rationale: This is a public Plugin SDK security-policy surface, and automation cannot choose the taxonomy, redaction boundary, or ordinary-versus-trusted plugin visibility without maintainer/security intent.

options.title: Define unified policy facts
options.body: Approve one additive contract covering action/capability facts plus safe provenance fields, then implement it with docs, API baseline updates, and cross-path tests.

options.title: Land narrow provenance slices first
options.body: Accept narrower work such as external-content provenance while keeping this issue open for the broader action/provenance design.

options.title: Defer hook enrichment
options.body: Keep the existing hook shape and require security plugins to use tool names or trusted policy internals until the broader capability model is settled.

recommendation.title: Define unified policy facts
recommendation.body: Approve one additive contract covering action/capability facts plus safe provenance fields, then implement it with docs, API baseline updates, and cross-path tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The current hook type and dispatch surface in this checkout are attributed to this recent hook metadata work, making this the best available routing owner from local history.
